elements.name: Yard of a crowded bus station in Addis Ababa
Shorter young man seen from behind with olive backpack
Taller young man in blue denim jacket with nothing on his back
Five men in a half circle gesturing with open hands
Five men as dark faceless silhouettes against bright yard lamps

wrong_setting: There is no bus station at all, only a blank beige paper backdrop with scattered luggage (two bags and a suitcase) on the floor, so the frame reads as a studio or reference sheet rather than a night bus yard.
notes: Regenerate the whole scene: paint the night bus yard with lamps, buses and dust, add the denim-jacket companion and the five silhouetted men, drop the loose luggage, and restore the backpack lad's charcoal grey jacket, olive rolled trousers and blue closed-toe sandals in place of the white shirt, dark jeans and brown shoes.
